tools.name: site_info
tools.description: What this coupon site is: name, country, language, currency, how many shops and live offers it publishes, its main pages, and the sister sites for other countries. Call it first.

tools.name: search_shops
tools.description: Shops (merchants) on this site that have live coupons or offers, by name and/or category, with how many live offers each has. Without filters, the shops with most offers first.

tools.name: get_shop
tools.description: One shop by slug with its live coupons and offers (best first), its categories and the same shop on the sites of other countries. Each coupon `url` reveals the code on the site.

tools.name: list_coupons
tools.description: Live coupons and offers on this site, across shops or filtered by shop, category or kind. Sorted by `featured` (exclusive and top first, default), `newest` or `ending_soon`. Each coupon `url` reveals the code on the site.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The shop categories of this site (fashion, electronics, travel…), with their page on the site. Use a `slug` to filter `search_shops` or `list_coupons`.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Current and upcoming sales events and campaign pages on this site (Black Friday, CyberDay, Hot Sale, seasonal pages…), with their dates and page.
